Samira P: Hi team  first day check-in! My laptop and dock arrived but the USB-C display adapter in the box is a EU plug brick (I’m in CA). Also I can't see RedwoodCorp Wi-Fi from my coworking space (only RedwoodGuest). Opening INC-7788. Any quick fixes?

Ben (IT): Welcome Samira! Sorry about the adapter  that's on us. We'll send a US power adapter courier ASAP. For Wi-Fi, remote/coworking spots generally only expose Guest SSID. You should be able to use the VPN for internal resources. Do you have SecureConnect installed?

Samira P: Not yet. I can install it but I also need access to the internal docs to start onboarding tasks. Guest network blocks the Okta sign-in popup sometimes.

Ben (IT): Two options: (1) I can temporarily add a network exception for your Okta sign-in from the Guest network if you can share the coworking public IP (or) (2) I can remote into your laptop and finish onboarding steps before courier arrives. Which do you prefer?

Tess - People Ops: If courier timing helps, we can also delay any office-only meetups until you have the final adapter. Welcome again! :tada:

Samira P: I can give the coworking public IP  it's 72.204.12.88. Happy for you to do the temporary exception so I can finish signups. Remote control is fine too if that's faster.

Ben (IT): Thanks. I'll add a temporary firewall rule to allow 72.204.12.88 to reach auth.redwood.internal for the next 2 hours. Meanwhile install steps for SecureConnect (mac):
```
1) curl -O https://internal.redwood/downloads/secureconnect.dmg
2) open secureconnect.dmg and run installer
3) Sign in with Okta SSO
```
If the Okta popup is blocked, paste any error text here.

ship-bot: INC-7788 created; shipping label (US adapter) scheduled for pickup today.

Ben (IT): Temporary firewall rule applied. Try signing in now and tell me the exact error if it fails.

Samira P: Okta popped up, and I could finish the SSO flow. VPN connected and I can access the onboarding doc now. Thanks Ben!

ship-bot: INC-7788 state updated to "in_progress"; tracking: USPS 9400111899223928490123

Samira P: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will ping if the adapter swap or anything else blocks me before EOD. Off to meet the team! :wave:
